messages.subject: Getting WhatIf test results
messages.body_plain:
Hello dear WhatIf- developers and users,

Unfortunately, I cannot get WhatIf test results as the program gets stuck while ‘Performing the convex hull test…’ I have left it to run for many hours, but nothing has been changing. I was wondering if you could help me to fix the problem. Based on the coding examples from the WhatIf manual, I did the following steps (the only difference in the two datasets is the transformed corruption score):

library("WhatIf")
library(foreign)
library("data.table")
fcorr_s <- read.dta("fcorrupts-wl.dta")
cfnetcorrupt_s <- read.dta("cfnetcorrs-wl.dta")
fcorrupts <- as.data.frame(fcorr_s, row.names = NULL, optional = FALSE)
str(fcorrupts)
cfnetcorrs <- as.data.frame(cfnetcorrupt_s, row.names = NULL, optional = FALSE)
str(cfnetcorrupt_s)
my.result<-whatif(data=fcorrupts, cfact=cfnetcorrs)    – and here R gets stuck…

Thanks a lot in advance!

Best,
Nurjamal Omurkanova
-

messages.body_plain:
I suggest you try a simpler problem with fewer variables, just to make sure
you don't have some coding error. Usually whatif is fast.

---
